name: AppOwnerLicense
description: A license granting a user an app, with its validity window and lifecycle status.

global.schema:
type AppOwnerLicenseState {
  issuer: LicenseIssuerKind
  user: String
  app: PHID
  stage: PHID
  kind: String
  details: String
  issued: DateTime
  start: DateTime
  end: DateTime
  status: LicenseStatus!
  replacedBy: PHID
  revokedReason: String
}

enum LicenseIssuerKind {
  INVITE_CODE
  PUBLISHER_GRANT
  ACHRA_SUBSCRIPTION
}

enum LicenseStatus {
  ISSUED
  ACTIVE
  EXPIRED
  REVOKED
  REPLACED
}
global.initialValue:
{
  "issuer": null,
  "user": null,
  "app": null,
  "stage": null,
  "kind": null,
  "details": null,
  "issued": null,
  "start": null,
  "end": null,
  "status": "ISSUED",
  "replacedBy": null,
  "revokedReason": null
}

operations.name: ISSUE_LICENSE
operations.description: Issue a license. Dates are resolved by the caller because reducers are pure.
operations.schema:
input IssueLicenseInput {
  app: PHID!
  user: String!
  issuer: LicenseIssuerKind!
  kind: String
  stage: PHID
  details: String
  issued: DateTime!
  start: DateTime!
  end: DateTime
  licenseType: PHID
  issuedBy: String
}

errors.name: AlreadyIssuedError
errors.description: This license has already been issued

errors.name: EndBeforeStartError
errors.description: The end date precedes the start date

errors.name: MissingKindError
errors.description: A licence needs a kind (or, for a legacy licence, a licence type).

operations.name: ACTIVATE_LICENSE
operations.description: Move the license from ISSUED to ACTIVE.

errors.name: InvalidStatusTransitionError
errors.description: The license status does not permit this transition

operations.name: EXPIRE_LICENSE
operations.description: Expire an ISSUED or ACTIVE license. ISSUED to EXPIRED is deliberate: it avoids provisioning an environment only to tear it down.

errors.name: InvalidStatusTransitionError
errors.description: The license status does not permit this transition

operations.name: REVOKE_LICENSE
operations.description: Revoke an ISSUED or ACTIVE license, recording a reason.

errors.name: InvalidStatusTransitionError
errors.description: The license status does not permit this transition

operations.name: REPLACE_LICENSE
operations.description: Mark an ACTIVE license as replaced by another.

errors.name: InvalidStatusTransitionError
errors.description: The license status does not permit this transition

operations.name: SET_STAGE
operations.description: Bind the licence to the environment it is served by.

errors.name: NotIssuedError
errors.description: The licence has not been issued.

operations.name: MIGRATE_LICENSE
operations.description: One-time, system-only conversion of a pre-terms licence onto a kind and a DID.

errors.name: NotIssuedError
errors.description: The licence has not been issued.

errors.name: AlreadyMigratedError
errors.description: The licence already carries a kind.
